name: custos_job_run
comment: One row per run of a batch job (the re-audit, the cluster month, the bibliography recheck), written by the shared frame at the start and again at the end of the run. A later column is a schema update, never a reinterpretation of one of these.

columns.name: cj_job
columns.comment: The job's name: reaudit, cluster or recheck

columns.name: cj_done
columns.comment: When the run ended; NULL while it runs (a run that never ended stays NULL)

columns.name: cj_outcome
columns.comment: DONE, NOTHING DUE, DEFERRED, JOB CONTEXT, SOURCE FAILING, REFUSED, FAULT or INTEGRITY HALT; empty until the run ends

columns.name: cj_detail
columns.comment: The run's scrubbed words: no path, no query, no server name

columns.name: cj_counts
columns.comment: The run's counts as a JSON object text; the empty object when it counted nothing
